propositions: Jira work is currently scattered across differ, apply wrapper, Cloud ACLI/REST, DC SDK, handlers, and batch orchestration with multiplied retry ownership and no unified failure classification mechanism

A provider-neutral coordinator must encapsulate immutable TicketPlan values carrying Mutations, lifecycle intents, dependencies, diagnostics, and disposition, with global selection/filter/caps running before any remote effect
Each logical postcondition must complete within three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep, with Retry-After as a lower bound and retry deferral via retry_not_before if it cannot fit

An endpoint-failure scoped fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted logical outcomes across at least two tickets, distinct from and retained alongside the existing per-pass blast-radius guard
Create operations must use label-first containment (rebar-id:<local_id>) with optional property second and safety-abort if local persistence fails

Shadow planning must validate normalized outcomes without writes before cutover, with per-operation-family rollout and rollback that never deletes successful Jira effects or re-observes commit-unknown work
